title: On the identifiability and semi-algebraicity of ReLU neuromanifolds
summary: We study several aspects of the semi-algebraicity of the neuromanifold $\mathcal{M}_{\mathbf{d}}$ of a feedforward ReLU neural network. We prove that $\mathcal{M}_{\mathbf{d}}$ in general is not a semi-algebraic quotient of the space of parameters of the network, but it can be approximated (in a precise sense) by semi-algebraic spaces. We then consider the notion of identifiable subsets of the space of parameters, where the network does not have any hidden symmetries.
